messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 2):
"""
In Order to remove any doubts or difficulties that may arise in the application or interpretation or any of the provisions of this Master Circular, the Competent Authority may issue appropriate clarifications, as and when deemed necessary. This has approval of the Competent Authority. Ramana Rao A Chief General Manager INDEX Sl No. Ref/Chapter Description Page no. 1. Effective date 4 2. Chapter I General Information for the Policy Holder/Prospect/Customer 4 3. Chapter II Broad Requirements to be complied with by the Insurer for offering Health Insurance Business: A. General Principles B. Performance Monitoring of TPAs C. Product Management Committee and Advertisement Committee D. Product Filing 11 13 14 15 4. Chapter III Miscellaneous Provisions: I. Model Product for Persons with Disabilities, Persons afflicted with HIV/AIDS and those with Mental Illness II. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number III.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

General Principles B. Performance Monitoring of TPAs\""]}]}
